rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a person, quality, achievement, or act that deserves admiration.

example.english: This young person's donating all their prize money is truly admirable.
example.traditional: 呢個年輕人捐出全部獎金，真係值得敬佩。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 nin4 hing1 jan4 gyun1 ceot1 cyun4 bou6 zoeng2 gam1 zan1 hai6 zik6 dak1 ging3 pui3

rows.note: Use this for a good or commendable act when the emphasis is on praising it rather than admiring the person.

example.english: Your taking the initiative to help a neighbour move is truly admirable.
example.traditional: 你肯主動幫街坊搬屋，真係值得稱讚。
example.jyutping: nei5 hang2 zyu2 dung6 bong1 gaai1 fong1 bun1 uk1 zan1 hai6 zik6 dak1 cing1 zaan3

rows.note: Use this only when admirable means heroic or exceptionally brave.

example.english: The firefighter's rushing into the burning building to save people was truly admirable.
example.traditional: 消防員衝入火場救人，真係英勇。
example.jyutping: siu1 fong4 jyun4 cung1 jap6 fo2 coeng4 gau3 jan4 zan1 hai6 jing1 jung5
